source_id: BR-GYM-001 — valid student coordinator
purpose: Club creation is rejected when the coordinator_id does not refer to a valid student.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. coordinator_id refers to a non-existent or non-student user.

source_id: BR-GYM-001 — valid student co-coordinator
purpose: Club creation is rejected when the co_coordinator_id does not refer to a valid student.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. co_coordinator_id refers to a non-student user.

source_id: BR-GYM-001 — valid replacement leader on leadership change
purpose: Leadership change is rejected when either proposed replacement is not a valid student.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. New coordinator_id refers to a non-student user.

source_id: BR-GYM-002 — valid faculty councillor on club creation
purpose: Club creation is rejected when faculty_councillor_id does not refer to a valid faculty member.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. faculty_councillor_id refers to a student, not faculty.

source_id: BR-GYM-002 — valid faculty councillor on event booking
purpose: Event booking is rejected when faculty_councillor_id does not refer to a valid faculty member.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. faculty_councillor_id is invalid.

source_id: BR-GYM-003 — allowed categories accepted
purpose: Club creation succeeds for each of the three allowed categories: technical, sports, cultural.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. All other fields valid.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/clubs/ three times with category='technical', 'sports', 'cultural' respectively.
expected_result: HTTP 201 for each. Three clubs created.

source_id: BR-GYM-003 — disallowed category rejected
purpose: Club creation is rejected for any category not in {technical, sports, cultural}.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. All other fields valid.

source_id: BR-GYM-004 — new club starts as open
purpose: A newly created club has status='open'.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. All fields valid.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Response and DB show status='open'.

source_id: BR-GYM-004 — only Student Admin can confirm club
purpose: Only Student Admin can confirm an open club; a regular student's attempt is rejected.
preconditions: An open club exists. Regular student authenticated (not Student Admin).

source_id: BR-GYM-004 — confirmation changes status to confirmed
purpose: Student Admin approval changes an open club's status to confirmed.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. Open club exists.

source_id: BR-GYM-005 — start before end accepted
purpose: A booking with start_time strictly before end_time is accepted.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. No conflict.

source_id: BR-GYM-005 — equal start and end time rejected
purpose: A booking where start_time equals end_time is rejected.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.

source_id: BR-GYM-005 — end before start rejected
purpose: A booking where end_time precedes start_time is rejected.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.

source_id: BR-GYM-006 — session-session overlap rejected
purpose: A new session booking overlapping an existing session in the same venue/date is rejected.
preconditions: Session A occupies venue V, date D, 10:00-12:00.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. New session not created.

source_id: BR-GYM-006 — event-event overlap rejected
purpose: A new event booking overlapping an existing event in the same venue/date is rejected.
preconditions: Event A occupies venue V, date D, 10:00-12:00.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/event/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. New event not created.

source_id: BR-GYM-006 — session-event cross-type overlap rejected
purpose: A new session booking overlapping an existing event in the same venue/date is rejected.
preconditions: Event A occupies venue V, date D, 10:00-12:00.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.

source_id: BR-GYM-006 — event-session cross-type overlap rejected
purpose: A new event booking overlapping an existing session in the same venue/date is rejected.
preconditions: Session A occupies venue V, date D, 10:00-12:00.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/event/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.

source_id: BR-GYM-006 — non-overlapping same-venue booking accepted
purpose: A booking in the same venue on the same day but with a non-overlapping time slot is accepted.
preconditions: Session A occupies venue V, date D, 10:00-12:00. No other conflicts.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ for venue V, date D, 12:00-14:00.

source_id: BR-GYM-007 — membership only for confirmed club
purpose: Membership application is rejected when the target club is not confirmed (status='open').
preconditions: Student authenticated. Club has status='open'.

source_id: BR-GYM-007 — membership allowed for confirmed club
purpose: Membership application is accepted when the target club is confirmed.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Club status='confirmed'. No prior application from this student.

source_id: BR-GYM-008 — multiple different-club applications allowed
purpose: A student with an existing application to Club A is not blocked from applying to Club B.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Application to Club A exists. Club B is confirmed and distinct.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Application to Club B created.

source_id: BR-GYM-009 — duplicate same-club application rejected
purpose: A second application by the same student to the same club is rejected.
preconditions: Student has an existing open application to Club A.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Duplicate not created. Existing application unchanged.

source_id: BR-GYM-010 — Club Head authorization accepted for coordinator
purpose: The club coordinator can perform Club Head operations (e.g., book session) for their club.
preconditions: User is the current coordinator of Club A.

source_id: BR-GYM-010 — non-Club-Head rejected for Club Head operations
purpose: A student who is not the coordinator or co-coordinator of a club cannot perform Club Head operations for it.
preconditions: Student authenticated but is NOT coordinator or co-coordinator of Club A.

source_id: BR-GYM-011 — membership approval transitions to confirmed
purpose: Approving an open membership application changes its status from open to confirmed.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Open membership application exists for their club.

source_id: BR-GYM-011 — optional remarks retained
purpose: Optional remarks provided during approval are stored on the membership record.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Open membership application exists.
expected_result: HTTP 200. remarks='Well qualified' stored on the application.

source_id: BR-GYM-012 — poll with exactly two choices accepted
purpose: A poll with exactly two choices meets the minimum requirement and is created successfully.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.

source_id: BR-GYM-012 — poll with one choice rejected
purpose: A poll with fewer than two choices is rejected.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.

source_id: BR-GYM-013 — poll notification sent only to target batch/branch
purpose: On poll creation, a notification is dispatched to the target groups defined by batch and branch.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Target groups specify batch='2024', branch='CSE'.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Notification task enqueued scoped to batch=2024, branch=CSE audience.

source_id: BR-GYM-014 — eligible student in target group can access active poll
purpose: A student in the target batch/branch can access an active, unexpired poll.
preconditions: Active poll targeting batch=2024, branch=CSE. Student belongs to batch=2024, branch=CSE. Poll not expired.

source_id: BR-GYM-014 — ineligible student (wrong batch/branch) cannot vote
purpose: A student not in the target batch/branch is refused when attempting to vote.
preconditions: Active poll targeting batch=2024, branch=CSE. Student belongs to batch=2023, branch=ECE.

source_id: BR-GYM-014 — expired poll access denied
purpose: A student cannot vote in an expired poll.
preconditions: Poll with expires_at in the past. Student is otherwise eligible.

source_id: BR-GYM-015 — one vote per student per poll enforced
purpose: A student who has already voted cannot cast a second vote in the same poll.
preconditions: Student has already voted in poll P.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. Vote not recorded. Tally unchanged.

source_id: BR-GYM-015 — tally incremented atomically on accepted vote
purpose: On a valid first vote, the choice's vote_count is incremented by exactly 1.
preconditions: Active poll. Eligible student has not voted. Choice C has vote_count=0.
expected_result: Choice C vote_count=1. No other choice tally changed.

source_id: BR-GYM-016 — leadership succession replaces active assignments
purpose: After a leadership change, the previous coordinator and co-coordinator are no longer current leaders.
preconditions: Club with coordinator=A, co_coordinator=B. Valid replacement students C and D. Club Head authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Club shows coordinator=C, co_coordinator=D. A and B are not current leaders.

source_id: BR-GYM-017 — non-negative amount accepted
purpose: A budget request with amount=0 (boundary) is accepted.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Valid supporting file provided.

source_id: BR-GYM-017 — negative amount rejected
purpose: A budget request with a negative amount is rejected.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.

source_id: BR-GYM-018 — missing supporting file rejected
purpose: A budget request without the required supporting file is rejected.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Amount is non-negative.

source_id: BR-GYM-019 — missing report file rejected
purpose: An event report submission without the required report/details file is rejected.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.

source_id: BR-GYM-019 — report with file accepted
purpose: An event report submission with all required fields including report_file is accepted.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. All required fields including report_file provided.

source_id: BR-GYM-020 — booking with configured venue accepted
purpose: A session booking using a venue from the configured list is accepted.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Venue is in the configured venue list. No conflict.

source_id: BR-GYM-020 — booking with unconfigured venue rejected
purpose: A session booking using a venue not in the configured list is rejected.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.

source_id: BR-GYM-021 — assigned councillor can access club reports
purpose: The assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access event reports for their club.
preconditions: Faculty Councillor authenticated and assigned to Club X. Report exists for Club X.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Reports for Club X are returned.

source_id: BR-GYM-021 — unassigned faculty denied access to club reports
purpose: A faculty member not assigned as councillor to Club X cannot view Club X's reports.
preconditions: Faculty member authenticated but assigned to Club Y, not Club X. Report exists for Club X.
action_or_input: GET /api/v1/gymkhana/reports/ or GET specific Club X report.
expected_result: HTTP 403, 404, or empty list. No Club X report content exposed.
